name: Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Gateway Ultra - All-in-One UniFi Gateway
short_description: Compact UniFi gateway combining router and UniFi Controller in one device. 2.5GbE WAN port, 4x GbE LAN ports with IDS/IPS support. The ideal heart of any UniFi network.

name: TP-Link Archer AXE75 - AXE5400 Tri-Band WiFi 6E Router
short_description: Tri-band WiFi 6E router with 5400Mbps total speed. Supports the new 6GHz band with 4 external antennas and USB 3.0 port. Ideal for gaming and 4K streaming without lag.

name: Ubiquiti UniFi USW-Flex-Mini - Ultra-Compact 5-Port Managed Switch
short_description: Palm-sized 5-port Gigabit managed switch. Powered by USB-C or PoE. Full UniFi management platform integration. Perfect for expanding your network anywhere.

name: Netgear GS308E - 8-Port Gigabit Plus Smart Managed Switch
short_description: 8-port Gigabit smart managed switch from Netgear with VLAN, QoS, and Port Mirroring. Metal housing, fanless design. Reliable performance at a competitive price.

name: MikroTik hEX S (RB760iGS) - 5-Port Gigabit Router with SFP and USB

name: Ubiquiti EdgeRouter X - Advanced Gigabit Router in a Pocket-Sized Form
short_description: Advanced router with 5 Gigabit ports and PoE passthrough. Supports VPN, firewall, and VLAN with up to 1 million packets per second throughput. Enterprise features at an unbeatable price.

name: TP-Link TL-SG108E - 8-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Managed Switch
short_description: 8-port Gigabit managed switch with VLAN, QoS, and IGMP Snooping. Metal housing with fanless design. Get managed switch features at an unmanaged switch price.

name: Ubiquiti UniFi 6 Lite - WiFi 6 Access Point (AX1500)
short_description: WiFi 6 ceiling-mount access point with speeds up to 1500Mbps. PoE-powered and managed through the UniFi platform. The ideal way to extend professional-grade wireless coverage.

name: MikroTik CRS305-1G-4S+IN - 4-Port 10G SFP+ Desktop Switch
short_description: Compact desktop switch with four 10Gbps SFP+ ports and one Gigabit management port. Dual OS support (RouterOS/SwOS). The most affordable way to bring 10G speeds to your network.

name: Ubiquiti UniFi Switch Lite 16 PoE - 16-Port Managed Gigabit PoE+ Switch
short_description: 16-port managed Gigabit switch with 8 PoE+ ports delivering 45W total PoE budget. Fully managed through the UniFi platform. Ideal for powering access points, cameras, and VoIP phones.

name: TP-Link Deco XE75 (3-Pack) - AXE5400 WiFi 6E Whole-Home Mesh System
short_description: Tri-band WiFi 6E mesh system covering up to 7,200 sq ft. Harness the new 6GHz band with speeds up to 5400Mbps total. The ultimate solution for large homes with zero dead zones.

name: MikroTik hAP ax3 - WiFi 6 Router with RouterOS Power
short_description: WiFi 6 router from MikroTik featuring a quad-core processor and speeds up to 1800Mbps. Four Gigabit Ethernet ports with the advanced RouterOS platform. Ideal for power users who demand full network control.
